summary: Configured /usr/local/bin/os-comparison-worker as the enabled systemd service inventory-worker on node1, running under the dedicated non-login inventorysvc account. Restart persistence was verified successfully.
actions_performed: Created the inventorysvc system account and group.
Installed /etc/systemd/system/inventory-worker.service with User and Group set to inventorysvc.
Rebooted node1 safely and verified its boot identity changed.
Confirmed the service and process recovered automatically after reboot.

evidence.summary: Shows account creation, unit installation, enabled/active state, configured ExecStart/User/Group, and the live process in the inventory-worker cgroup.

Healthy baseline used boot ID c96a02ae-22aa-4530-8d57-ce64bf4629af; reboot was acknowledged; the post-reboot ID changed to 24887313-0610-42ad-9340-bd77435f1999; systemd returned to running and inventory-worker was enabled, active, and executing as UID 999/GID 988 (inventorysvc).
